Inspection Checklist

☐ Air inlets and exhaust points clear and not blocked

☐ Fans, ducts and hoods in good condition, no unusual noise or vibration

☐ Local exhaust capture velocity verified at the source

☐ Filters clean and within change interval

☐ No recirculation of contaminated air or short-circuiting of airflow

☐ Smoke test shows airflow toward the extraction point

☐ Workers do not report odours, headaches, dizziness or irritation

☐ Last statutory LEV / ventilation test is in date
